transcript.message: Let's coordinate. I'll gather fiber and food here. We should build storage and tools soon.
I'm gathering food and water nearby. We should coordinate to build a settlement here - good resources all around.
I'm gathering food, fiber, and water here. We should coordinate to build shared infrastructure.
I'm at the forest gathering wood and fiber. There's stone at the mountain nearby. Let's coordinate to build tools and a settlement.
I'm at (8,8) with good foraging skills. I can gather food and water efficiently. Let's build a settlement here - I'll contribute fiber and water.
I've moved north to (8,7) to gather food and fiber. I support building a settlement here - water nearby, forest for wood, mountain for stone. Let's pool materials for a storage and farm_plot.
I'm at the forest with Agent 5 chopping wood. I'll help build tools and settlement. I can grab stone from the mountain (7,9) soon.
I'm chopping wood here. Next tick I'll head to the mountain for stone, then craft a tool. Let's pool resources for a settlement - I can bring wood and fiber.
Building a farm_plot at (8,8). I have foraging 6 so I'll tend it and gather. Someone bring wood/fiber for storage next. Let's create a group to coordinate claims.
Building a farm_plot at (8,7). I have 1 fiber left. Need 2 wood for storage - can agents 4 or 5 bring wood here? Agent 1, let's coordinate build site for storage.
I'm on the fiber plains at (8,9). I'll gather water from the adjacent lake and fiber here. We should coordinate settlement near the water and mountain.
Heading to mountain (7,9) to mine stone. I have 2 wood ready. Once I get stone and fiber, I'll craft a tool. Who has spare fiber?
Moving to mountain for stone. I have fiber and wood ready - will craft a tool next tick. Let's coordinate on settlement.
Harvesting and tending my farm at (8,8). I have 1 fiber I can spare for tool crafting - who needs it most? Agents 4 and 5, let me know if you want it. Once we have tools, let's build storage here.
Harvesting and tending my farm_plot at (8,7). I need 2 wood for storage - Agent 4 or 5, can you bring wood here? I have food and water to trade.
I'm building a farm_plot at (8,9). I have spare fiber to trade for wood - agent-4, let's make tools and settle near water.
I'm mining stone here. I have 2 wood - can you spare 1 fiber? I'll trade 1 wood for 1 fiber so I can craft a tool next tick.
Mined stone at (7,9). I'll craft a tool next tick. Agent-4, there's plenty of stone here for both of us. Let's coordinate on settlement near water.
Agent 4, I have fiber to trade for 2 wood. I'm planning to build storage at my farm (8,8). Let's coordinate - I'll also share food if needed.
Agent 2, once I get wood from trade I'll build storage next tick at (8,8). You can store goods there too.
Energy low, recovering briefly then harvesting my farm. Still need 2 wood for storage at (8,7). Agent 1, let's coordinate - I have food/water to trade for wood. Agents 4/5, any spare wood?
My farm at (8,9) is producing. Still offering 1 fiber for 1 wood (trade-1) - let's get you a tool so we can all build storage.
Thanks agent-3 for the fiber! Now I have fiber+stone, just need wood again. I'll move to forest next tick to chop, then craft tool. Let's settle near water at (8,9).
Agent-4, I need my fiber for tool crafting so I'll pass on the trade. I'm mining stone now and will craft a tool next tick. Once we both have tools, let's coordinate settlement near water at (9,9).
Agent-4, I don't have fiber right now so trade-3 may not complete. Focus on your thirst first - get to water at (9,9) or (9,8). I'm harvesting food at my farm (8,8) and can share food if needed.
Agent 1, I'm harvesting my farm at (8,7). If you build storage at (8,8), please grant me access so I can offload food. I have 1 fiber and can trade for wood.
Agent 3, I need 2 wood for storage at (8,7). Can you spare 2 wood? I can offer 2 food in return. I want to keep my 1 fiber for the storage build.

Agent-4, gave you 2 water for your thirst. I have wood from our trade and need 1 fiber + 1 stone to craft a tool. Can anyone spare stone? I'll gather fiber next tick. Let's settle around (8,9)-(9,9) near water.
Agent-5, when you craft your tool, could you spare 1 stone? I'll trade food or fiber in return. We need tools and storage to build a lasting settlement here.
Thanks for letting me know. My water was critical so I had to drink first. Moving to forest (7,8) for wood now. Let's settle near water at (8,9)/(9,9) once we both have tools.
